Factions.Name: Doriath
Factions.Description: The hidden Sindarin woodland realm of King Thingol and Melian. Doriath relies on concealment, ambush, and prepared forest ground; it is less comfortable in open-field battles.

Technologies.Name: Girdle of Melian
Technologies.History: Melian's girdle folds the mist about the Thousand Caves, and no foe may pass the thresholds of Thingol unseen.

Technologies.Name: Green-weave Training
Technologies.History: The Green-elves of Doriath learn to move between trunks without stirring a leaf, and to see all while being seen by none.

Technologies.Name: Guardianship of the Greenwood
Technologies.History: The woodland folk take only what the forest can spare, leaving each tree with strength to live and grow.
Technologies.Description: Gatherers leave at least 5% of each tree's wood unharvested.

Technologies.Name: March-wardens of Doriath
Technologies.History: The March-wardens guard the borders of the hidden kingdom, raising their halls swiftly along the marches.

Technologies.Name: Sindar Forging
Technologies.History: The forges of Menegroth temper axe and blade for the hidden kingdom's wardens, keen enough for a single clean stroke.

Technologies.Name: Song of Things Unseen
Technologies.History: The masons of Menegroth shape stone deep beneath the forest, building halls that endure like the trees above.

Technologies.Name: Warden's Glade
Technologies.History: In Doriath's guarded glades, field and forest yield together, and gatherers take only what the woodland can spare.
Technologies.Description: Workers +15% food and wood gather rate.

Heroes.Name: Thingol
Heroes.History: King Thingol leads Doriath's infantry with a local combat bonus.

Heroes.Name: Melian
Heroes.History: Melian heals nearby allies and strengthens the slowing, obscuring Girdle around her.

Heroes.Name: Beleg
Heroes.History: Beleg Strongbow is a long-range archer whose guidance improves nearby archers.

CivBonuses.Name: Hidden Kingdom
CivBonuses.History: Behind the Girdle of Melian, the Sindar and Marchwardens of Doriath learned to fight as the forest fights: unseen until the moment of the blow.
CivBonuses.Description: Doriath Rangers conceal themselves while stationary in forest. Concealment breaks on movement, attack, damage, or when enemies come close. Inside the Girdle they are revealed only at close range.

CivBonuses.Name: The Girdle of Melian
CivBonuses.History: Melian girdled all Doriath about with a fence of mist and shadow, so that the hidden kingdom lay unseen, and those who entered it wandered lost.
CivBonuses.Description: Doriath Civic Centres project a woodland mist: enemy units within it move -10% slower and see -15% less. Menegroth deepens the Girdle further. Destroy the sources to lift it.

CivBonuses.Name: Melian's Guard
CivBonuses.History: The halls of Menegroth and the spear-wards of the Marchwardens keep the hidden kingdom, rewarding prepared woodland defense over open-field battle.
CivBonuses.Description: Woodland-tempered infantry with strong anti-cavalry spears, but weaker in open-ground slugging matches than the coastal hosts of Lindon.

Structures.Name: Menegroth
Structures.History: The Thousand Caves are the hidden halls and seat of King Thingol.
Structures.Description: Doriath's wonder deepens the Girdle around it and researches the Girdle of Melian.

Structures.Name: Grove of the Shepherds
Structures.History: The Ents, ancient shepherds of the forest, gather in this living moot.
Structures.Description: Trains Ent-allies, Doriath's organic answer to walls and siege engines.

Structures.Name: Hunter's Cache
Structures.History: A small forward camp where hunters can bring their food to safety.
Structures.Description: A cheap food-only dropsite that can be built near wildlife.
